mutants.name: repeat-never-relogged

mutants.name: interval-zero
mutants.why: setting _DECLINE_REPEAT_SECS=0 re-logs every repeat immediately; z3 expects all repeats inside 300 s to stay quiet but they all re-log

mutants.name: count-not-carried
mutants.why: hardcoding 0 in the suffix means the re-log always says '0 rescan(s)'; z1 asserts '10 rescan(s)' at 330 s
mutants.anchor: suffix = f" — still {outcome}: {last['count']} rescan(s) since the first at {last['first'].strftime('%H:%M:%S')}"

mutants.name: count-reset-at-each-repeat
mutants.why: resetting count to 1 on every repeat means cumulative count is never carried; z2 expects count=3 at 600 s but gets 1

mutants.name: interval-from-first-not-last
mutants.why: not updating logged_at means the interval is always measured from the first decline; z2 expects the t=599 repeat to stay quiet but the mutation makes it re-log (599-0=599>=300)
mutants.replacement: pass  # m5: interval from first, not last

mutants.name: memo-kept-across-proceed
mutants.why: not popping the memo on proceed leaves the old decline entry; z5's second decline finds the stale entry and stays silent instead of logging in full

mutants.name: repeat-without-hint
